_comment: Rename this file to config.json and edit as needed.
_layout_mode_comment: Must match the 'name' field in one of the JSON files in conf/. Run the controller without config.json to see available devices.
_display_mode_comment: Available modes depend on the device. Common: cpu_temp, gpu_temp, cpu_usage, gpu_usage, alternate_metrics, debug_ui.

_colors_comment: Array of hex colors, one per LED (must match total_leds in device JSON).
Shortcuts: repeat one color for all LEDs.
